changelog:
palaia v2.8.0 adds OpenClaw 2026.5.7 compatibility and improves plugin reliability.

- Now compatible with OpenClaw 2026.5.7 using ContextEngineFactoryContext for workspace resolution.
- Uses registerMemoryCapability for memory prompt guidance in the OpenClaw plugin.
- Memory injection skips turns if no memory tools are available, improving stability.
- Respects citationsMode when active for better compliance.
- No manual action required; everything continues to work as before.
